sn55.46:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparayāno ||
sn55.46:2.1: katamehi catuhi || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || || Dhamme || Saṅghe || || Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
